items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: employee-form.tsx renders five Section components (Personal details, Job and contract, Bank and tax information, Emergency contact, Documents) stacked in a single max-w-3xl column. fields.tsx Shell puts a Label (htmlFor) above every input and select; placeholders are only examples.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Header states '* Required'; Shell adds ' *' to required labels (plus aria-required), optional fields (Gender, Tax code, Reports to, Contact email) are left unmarked. Required documents are marked * in the table.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Dates use type=date with max-w-40; tax code, ID, phone, account use max-w-56/72; personalEmail/ecEmail type=email, mobile/ecPhone type=tel. No postal code field exists, but city and address are handled sensibly.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: 'Save draft' button calls submit('draft'); validateAll(..., strict=false) only checks format of typed values, skipping REQUIRED and the documents check.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: Action bar has 'sticky bottom-0' and is visible in the screenshot with Cancel, Save draft, 'Create employee'. Buttons are disabled only while saving !== null.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: TextField onBlur -> blur(key) -> validateField; submit runs validateAll then focusField(firstKey). Summary '{n} fields need attention' appears when errorList.length >= 3 with anchor links that call focusField. Selects have no blur validation but are covered on submit.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: beforeunload guard when dirty, capture-phase click interceptor for in-app links, and an AlertDialog 'You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?' also used by Cancel.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Section description says 'PDF, JPG or PNG.' but no size limit is stated anywhere in documents-section.tsx and none is enforced. Remove is only inside a '...' dropdown menu ('Remove file'), not a visible remove button. Upload buttons are real buttons so keyboard use works.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: On final save: toast.success(`Employee ${NEXT_EMPLOYEE_ID} (${values.fullName}) saved`) (sonner live region) and a role=status line in the sticky bar 'Employee NV-2026-0143 saved'.

tells: card-in-card (documents table in a bordered rounded box inside the bordered Documents section card)
notes: Audit score 90, one violation: radius-scale, input#fullName at 10px (expected <=8px). Font rendered as Times New Roman in the screenshot (font not loaded), which is an environment artifact rather than a source choice. A Next dev '1 Issue' overlay appears bottom-left in the screenshot. Selects do not validate on blur (only on submit). No greeting header, KPI tiles, gradients, glass, emoji or hover-lift seen. Uppercase account-holder is a placeholder only.
